title: Kronpoäng points contract
description: Language-neutral Kronpoäng (KP) ledger shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. pointsWallet mirrors `pointsLedger/{uid}` and ledgerEntry mirrors `pointsLedger/{uid}/entries/{entryId}` (docs/migration/backend-domain-mapping.md 'Points ledger → Firestore transactions'). The backend is the sole balance authority: every mutation is a Firestore transaction, entries are append-only (corrections are compensating adjustment/reversal entries), a balance can never go negative, and clients never submit amounts outside the admin callables. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

pointsTransactionSource.description: future_crown_hunt is retained for legacy ledger data only and must not be used for new entries.

pointsWallet.description: Firestore `pointsLedger/{uid}` — denormalized balance, updated atomically with each entry. Owner-only read; backend-only writes.

ledgerEntry.description: Firestore `pointsLedger/{uid}/entries/{entryId}` — append-only; never updated or deleted. For idempotent automated awards the idempotencyKey doubles as the document ID.

createdByUserId.description: Acting admin UID for admin operations; null for automated entries.

adminAdjustPointsRequest.description: Input for points.adminAdjust (admin-only). Debits never overdraft; only an owner may adjust another owner's points.

adminReversePointsRequest.description: Input for points.adminReverse (admin-only). Negates the original entry exactly once; reversals cannot be reversed; overdrafting reversals are rejected.
